errors.evidence: The chart label is "Лук кромид - зрял" (Onion - mature). The description incorrectly appends "(вкл. лют)" (incl. hot), which belongs to the previous category, "пипер" (pepper).
The full label on the chart's x-axis is "тикви и кратуни" (pumpkins and gourds). The description omits "и кратуни".

errors.text_span: подредени по низходящ ред според добивите през 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The vegetable categories on the x-axis are sorted in descending order based on the 2022 yields (blue bars), not the 2023 yields (orange bars).
The y-axis has major gridlines and labels at intervals of 20,000, not 10,000.
The highest bar in the entire chart is the blue bar (2022) for potatoes, not an orange bar (2023).
The orange bar for potatoes (2023) is approximately 118,000 tons. The highest bar overall (blue for potatoes, 2022) is approximately 173,000 tons. Neither is over 180,000 tons.
The description incorrectly combines two separate categories from the x-axis: "тикви и кратуни" and "краставици и корнишони".
The shortest bar in the chart, which is for "краставици и корнишони" in 2022, corresponds to a value of approximately 4,000 tons, not just over 1,000 tons.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за картофи и дини показват по-високи стойности през 2023 г. в сравнение с 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect for both crops. For potatoes, the 2023 yield (~118,000) is significantly lower than in 2022 (~173,000). For watermelons (дини), the yields are approximately equal in both years (~80,000).

errors.text_span: докато за другите зеленчуци стойностите са относително близки в двете години.
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. While some crops have similar values (e.g., watermelons, carrots), others show notable changes, such as the increase for onions ('Лук кромид - зрял') from ~27,000 to ~40,000 tons.
